name: tr_jimmy
caption:
IF JIMMY HAD A POKÉMON TEAM, HERE'S WHO WE'D SEND OUT 🎮🏀

🐜 Trapinch: a patient hunter waiting at the bottom of its pit. No recruiters, then pick #30, last in round 1
🐉 Flygon: Trapinch evolves into the Desert Spirit. 2015 Most Improved Player
🦹 Sneasel: its ability is Pickpocket. Led the NBA in steals in 2021
🌋 Heatran: blood that boils like magma. Playoff Jimmy, 56 points in one playoff game, a Heat record
⚡ Zeraora: it moves at the speed of lightning. 38 in his first play-in for us
🔥 Moltres: when hurt, it dips into magma to heal. 20.0 points a night in 38 games before the ACL

That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? 👇

Monster sprites: PMD Sprite Collab (sprites.pmdcollab.org), CC BY-NC 4.0

beats.vo: If Jimmy Butler had a Pokemon team, here's what we'd be running.
beats.dlg: IF JIMMY HAD A TEAM|OF MONSTERS...

beats.vo: First up, Trapinch. A patient hunter, it waits at the bottom of its pit. Nobody recruited him out of high school. Then pick thirty, the last pick of round one.
beats.dlg: A PATIENT HUNTER.|PICK 30, LAST IN ROUND 1.

beats.vo: Flygon. Trapinch evolves into the Desert Spirit. Most Improved Player in twenty fifteen.
Sneasel. Its ability is Pickpocket, and it steals eggs from unguarded nests. He led the whole league in steals in twenty twenty-one.
beats.dlg: ABILITY: PICKPOCKET.|LED THE NBA IN STEALS!

beats.vo: Heatran. Boiling blood, like magma, runs through its body. Playoff Jimmy. Fifty-six points in one playoff game, a Heat record.
beats.dlg: BLOOD BOILS LIKE MAGMA.|56 IN A PLAYOFF GAME!

beats.vo: Zeraora. It strikes at the speed of lightning. His first play-in for us: thirty-eight points to beat Memphis.
beats.dlg: FAST AS A LIGHTNING STRIKE|38 VS MEMPHIS IN PLAY-IN!

beats.vo: And the ace. Moltres. When it's hurt, it's said to dip into magma to heal. Twenty points a night for us before the knee. Come back soon, Jimmy.
beats.dlg: IT HEALS ITSELF IN MAGMA.|20.0 A NIGHT. COME BACK!

beats.vo: That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? Comment below.
beats.dlg: A PARTY WE'D TAKE INTO|ANY BUILDING. WHO'S IN?

facts.claim: Butler: not recruited out of high school, went to Tyler Junior College; 2011 draft 30th overall by Chicago, the last pick of the first round (pick 31 started round 2); 2015 NBA Most Improved Player; NBA steals leader in 2021; career-high 56 points in game 4 vs Milwaukee in 2023, Miami Heat franchise playoff record; April 15 (2025) play-in debut with the Warriors: 38 points in a 121-116 win over Memphis; torn right ACL January 19, 2026; through 38 games averaged 20.0 points
2011 NBA draft: Jimmy Butler round 1 pick 30 (30th) by Chicago; round 2 pick 31 Bojan Bogdanovic
